title: TcStormErrors
description: One line of tc/archive/<YYYY>/errors.jsonl (docs/tc.md section 9.2): one storm's verified cases, by truth and source, one column per field and one row per (base, lead). That the columns are of one length is the readers' own check.

truths.description: Best-track key, then source, to its cases.

ErrorColumns.description: One source's cases against one truth.

along.description: Along the best track's motion, km, positive ahead; null with no motion to resolve it on.

cross.description: Across it, km, positive to the right.

vmax.description: Forecast minus truth, m/s; null where either is missing.

pmin.description: Forecast minus truth, hPa; null where either is missing.
